findings.label: _handle_interactive_send kept, against an explicit acceptance criterion
findings.detail: Narrowed to location_request, cta_url, flow, address_message and catalog_message per plan decision D1 instead of deleted wholesale. Deleting it would break the Razorpay post-payment flow send (payments/razorpay-webhook:1552), the submit/track-request flows (inbound 4613/4679/4814), India checkout address collection (inbound:5205) and every inbound cta_url button (8 call sites) - all of which the same acceptance list requires to stay intact. The four menu-shaped branches (list, button, product, product_list) are gone and the else arm returns a JSON error naming the removal. Needs owner ratification of the carve-out, not a code change; enforcing the literal criterion would regress steering-protected payment and checkout paths.

findings.label: Staff menu-building UI still shipped
findings.detail: src/pages/workspace/engage/whatsapp/interactive-lists.tsx and its nav entry at src/config/navigation.ts:212 now hit the 410, and src/components/InteractiveMessageComposer.tsx still defaults to 'button' and offers 'list', both of which now get a 400 from outbound-whatsapp. Declared as a known consequence in plan sections 8 and 9, but it is residual WhatsApp menu-building surface under the owner's 'any menu anywhere' instruction. Follow-up: remove the page, the nav entry and the two composer modes.

findings.label: src/api/client.ts still advertises removed interactive types
findings.detail: The SendInteractiveRequest union at src/api/client.ts:921 still lists 'list' | 'button' | 'product' | 'product_list', and sendWhatsAppProducts (line 980) still posts product/product_list. These compile but 400 at runtime. Trim the union to the five surviving types.

findings.label: WhatsApp notification channel is now permanently ineligible
findings.detail: With WA_TEMPLATE_NAME defaulting to empty, every WhatsApp delivery records TEMPLATE_UNCONFIGURED and decide_whatsapp refuses. Harmless today because PSTN_CONNECTED_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED is absent, but enabling that flag needs an approved replacement template (wd_call_followup_v1) first. Both guards (policy and worker) are correctly ordered and pinned by new tests.

findings.label: Three self-service actions lost their only entry point
findings.detail: toggle_audio, toggle_notifications and human_handoff were reachable only from the deleted menu_* rows and have no typed keyword. The coder measured this and recorded it in verification.md section 9; they were already unreachable before this edit because every menu was deleted in phase 1. Restoring any of them is new work, not a revert.

findings.label: Minor dead surface in whatsapp-calling
findings.detail: _generate_ivr_tts_audio keeps an unused phone_number_id parameter, and the SystemConfig override row ivr_menu_{phone_number_id} (if any rows exist) is now read by nobody. Cosmetic; no runtime effect.

findings.label: Residual inert menu-shaped config in the AI handler
findings.detail: flowAction 'showOptions'/'showRating' emits and DEFAULT_BOT_FLOW['options']/['rating'] remain list-shaped config, and _tool_send_whatsapp_buttons still builds a type:'button' payload. Nothing renders any of it: inbound._process_ai_automation is a stub whose first statement is return None (verified by reading it), and the buttons tool never set isInteractive so it never reached _handle_interactive_send even before this change. Declared by the coder rather than silently left.
